citations.quote: For l = 1, K1 is the Omega–Sharpe ratio and for l = 2, K2 is the Sortino ratio.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Postmodern reward-to-downside ratios built on lower partial moments: downside variance is the 2nd LPM and downside potential the 1st; Omega, Omega-Sharpe, Sortino and Kappa are all special cases of the generalised Kappa K_l family indexed by moment order l.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Partial-Moment Ratios: Sortino, Omega, and Kappa
